name: B10-0209/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Escalating trafficking and exploitation by criminal groups in Haiti
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on escalating trafficking and exploitation by criminal groups in Haiti
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its position and asking the European Union to act on Haiti. It calls for more money and staff for the security force, and for human rights checks on its operations. It asks for aid, justice for victims of sexual violence, and programmes to help children leave gangs. It also criticises deportations to Haiti and cuts to aid.

- The European Union is asked to give more money, staff and monitoring to Haiti's security force.
- Children in gangs, displaced people and deportees would be the main people affected.
- The Parliament asks the European Union to act; it does not decide this itself.
